description: SwiftUI view for a chat message composer with attachment support, session/model selection, and macOS-specific file handling.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: NSViewRepresentable wrapper for NSTextView with custom paste and key handling.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: Custom NSTextView subclass handling paste, key events, and image pasting.

classes.name: ChatComposerPasteSupport
classes.description: Utility enum for handling image and file pasteboard types and conversions.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures NSScrollView containing the NSTextView.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSScrollView and NSTextView with current data and focus state.

methods.name: textDidChange
methods.description: NSTextViewDelegate method to sync text changes.

methods.name: keyDown
methods.description: Handles Return key for sending message or inserting newline.

methods.name: readSelection
methods.description: Handles pasting image attachments from pasteboard.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Overrides paste to handle image pastes.

methods.name: pasteAsPlainText
methods.description: Overrides pasteAsPlainText to handle image pastes.

methods.name: handleImagePaste
methods.description: Processes pasteboard for image or file URL attachments.

methods.name: loadAndDeliver
methods.description: Loads image data from file references and delivers.
